newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman ups Porsche target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman ups Porsche target.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Tuesday it raised its price target on sports car maker Dr.Ing.h.c.Porsche AG and repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock.
Analyst Chris Will upped his price target on the stock by 20 percent to 3,600 marks and raised his fiscal-1997 earnings per share estimate to 60 marks from 50.
Will also raised his fiscal-1998 target to 120 marks from 90 and his forecast for the following year to 210 marks from 160.

The Lehman analyst said a major component supply bottleneck, which had prevented Porshe from raising production volumes, had been cleared. This would allow the company to meet strong demand for its Boxster model, he said.
